meta.name: wiki_capture
meta.description: ktx's knowledge base - wiki pages for durable, reusable business knowledge. Covers capture workflow for user preferences, metric definitions, organizational conventions, and cross-references between wiki pages and semantic-layer sources. Loaded by the post-turn memory-agent only. The research agent reads wiki via `wiki_read`/`wiki_search` but does not write it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录团队业务知识到可复用的维基页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要持久化存储业务知识并方便检索
copy.tagline_en: Capture team business knowledge into reusable wiki pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to persist business knowledge and make it searchable

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在对话中自动识别并保存可复用的业务知识，如指标定义、过滤规则、数据映射等，写入知识库页面。它还会在写入前搜索已有内容，避免重复创建。
howto.when: 当用户或导入文档表达出可复用的业务规则、定义或约定时触发，例如定义指标、说明过滤条件或映射关系。

say.text: 请记住，收入是指退款后的已确认收入。
报告 ARR 时，始终排除测试账户。
say.note: Claude 会保存这条过滤规则到知识库。

say.text: mood_stress_sleep 等于 Oxytocin 协议。
say.note: Claude 会记录这个映射关系。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically identifies and saves reusable business knowledge during conversations, such as metric definitions, filter rules, and data mappings, writing them into wiki pages. It also searches existing content before writing to avoid duplicates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user or ingested document expresses a reusable business rule, definition, or convention, e.g., defining a metric, specifying a filter, or stating a mapping.

say_en.text: Please remember that revenue means booked revenue after refunds.
say_en.note: Claude will create or update a wiki page about the revenue definition.

say_en.text: Always exclude test accounts when reporting ARR.
say_en.note: Claude will save this filter rule to the knowledge base.
